description: This file defines a GameViewModel class for a Tic-Tac-Toe game, managing game state, scores, and interactions between the UI and game engine. It provides functions for handling cell taps, restarting games, and resetting scores, with a lightweight implementation that avoids AndroidX dependencies.

classes.name: GameViewModel
classes.description: A lightweight ViewModel managing game state and scores for a Tic-Tac-Toe game, with callback support for state changes.

classes.name: Scores
classes.description: Data class representing the count of wins for X, wins for O, and draws.

classes.name: UiState
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the current game state and scores.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles the event when a cell is tapped; updates game state accordingly.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the game, optionally updating scores based on the previous game's outcome.

methods.name: resetScoresAndRestart
methods.description: Resets scores and starts a new game.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the UI state and invokes the change callback if set.
